official_metadata.setting: Active lithium processing refinery in rural Mexico
official_metadata.official_description: A lithium extraction and processing facility situated beneath the Sierra mountains. Features industrial reaction tanks, overhead maintenance catwalks, control rooms, and interactive security doors connecting the inner refinery to exterior loading bays.
official_metadata.provenance: Activision / Infinity Ward Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Official Intel

cut_the_cake_suitability.analysis_notes: Cut the Cake Inference: Dynamic interactive doors introduce stateful geometric switching. Catwalks introduce secondary elevation layers requiring careful 2D planar projection.
